description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — fresh air and nature trails are the best reset. Would you like help turning that into an email or message (to Maria, family, or friends), a social post, or something else?

If helpful, here are two quick draft options you can use or edit:

- Message to Maria (casual)
  Hey Maria — I had such a lovely time on our countryside weekend. Thank you for the company and for all the laughs on the trails. Let’s plan another getaway soon! —[Your name]

- Email to friends (share photos/highlights)
  Subject: Weekend getaway — countryside highlights
  Hi everyone — I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. Attached are a few photos — the views were gorgeous and it was exactly the reset I needed. Hope you’re all doing well — would love to plan a group trip sometime!
  Best, [Your name]

Tell me which one you want to send (and to whom) or if you want a different tone/length — I can draft, save as a draft, or send it for you.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your sister Maria — you had a relaxing time, explored nature trails, and enjoyed the fresh air.

Would you like me to draft or send a message about the trip (to Maria or friends), or create a social post? I can use short or longer tones — tell me who it’s for.
